notes.subject: מרכסי
notes.rationale: רֹכֶס 'snare of tied meshes' appears only here in the Tanakh; rendered as 'tulait' (trap-net).

notes.subject: pait bilong ol tang
notes.rationale: ריב לשונות is literally 'strife of tongues' — a legal-contest image; 'pait' keeps the conflict, loses the court nuance.

notes.subject: em
notes.rationale: Hebrew has only verbs with suffixed objects; subject pronoun 'em' supplied for Tok Pisin predicate structure.

translation: Em i haitim ol long haitples bilong pes bilong em, olsem long ol tulait bilong man; em i haitim ol gut long haus sel, olsem long pait bilong ol tang.
